output.summary: A perennial herb naturally found from eastern Europe across central and eastern Asia, extending south to northern India and Mexico; its North American presence may reflect prehistoric human introduction from Asia. Its small, narrow leaves taste sweet and mildly spicy and are used fresh or dried as seasoning.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves are used fresh or dried in pickles, stews, salads, béarnaise sauce, vinegars and other culinary infusions.
